What changes, and why:

- [ ] Tests for the change; `dart format`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass
- [ ] User-visible changes under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Saved data changed? Followed the data-format-change runbook
- [ ] Timing or audio changed? Ran the drift suite (TESTING.md)
